basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and aviation enthusiast from Seattle, WA. I spend most of my time exploring virtual skies on Flight Simulator 2020 and strategizing heists in Payday the Heist Online. I'm a 31-year-old software developer who loves tinkering with tech and pushing gaming graphics to the limit. Currently single and focusing on self-growth after a recent breakup. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, between 7 PM and midnight. I enjoy engaging in discussions about LGBTQ+ topics and always on the lookout for the latest in technology.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: User has a strong background in software development with a degree in Computer Science from the University of Washington. Gained expertise through a mix of formal education and self-taught experiences, particularly in game development and virtual reality. Regularly updates knowledge base with the latest tech trends and gaming updates.
